messages.subject: Error: object 'combin' not found
parts:
Dear all,

One more question...

When I try to run a linearity test for the TVAR I obtain the following
error:

Error in TVAR.LRtest....
object 'combin' not found

The test runs perfectly if I use one of the endogenous variables as
threshold variable, and the estimation of the TVAR also runs normally
with an external threshold variable.... this error only arises when I
apply the test to a TVAR with an external transition variable.

Thanks in advance!!

Laura
